# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. Your `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay away from the whole site. That is the main reason the score is low. Behind it, the pages are built in the browser, so crawlers receive an empty page. The cap of 40 for a quotable blocker also applies (GEO-009), but the score is already below it. The one unknown is the canonical address, because the code doesn't declare your domain. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking all crawlers in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` asks every search engine and AI search crawler not to read any page, so nothing else you fix will be seen. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:1-2` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: *` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59. This fixes GEO-009 and GEO-014 together. It assumes you want to be found, since there's no `geo.config.json`. If the block is deliberate, say so and I'll leave it. ### 2. Put the page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** The server sends an empty `
`, and the text only appears after JavaScript runs. Crawlers that don't run JavaScript see a blank page. The catalogue is worse: its list is fetched in the browser after the page loads. - **Where:** `index.html:8` and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:5-7` - **What the code says:** `
` and `useEffect(() => {` - **Size:** Large (add prerendering or server rendering, for example with a Vite prerender plugin or a framework like React Router framework mode) - **Score after this:** 37–46 ### 3. Give each page its own title, description and `lang` - **Why it matters:** Every page currently has the title "Vite App" and no description. The `` tag has no `lang`, so tools can't tell what the page is or what language it's in. - **Where:** `index.html:2` and `index.html:5` - **What the code says:** `` and `Vite App` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 33–41 ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and reachable | Clear | `public/robots.txt`: valid lines, tiny file | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers are allowed in | Problem | `public/robots.txt:2` `Disallow: /` under `User-agent: *`. Site-wide. | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Problem | The same robots rule blocks Googlebot and Bingbot on both routes (`/`, `/catalogue`) | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical URL | Can't tell | No canonical tag anywhere, and no domain is declared. Which domain do you use? | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | `index.html:8` empty root, no prerendering. Both routes. | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and is listed | Problem | No sitemap source, and `robots.txt` has no `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description and lang | Problem | `index.html:5` is the same title on both routes, with no description and no `lang` | | GEO-016 | Key routes reached by real links | Problem | `src/main.jsx:11` ``. Crawlers can't follow a button. Use `Catalogue`, which also fixes GEO-016. - `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`: `{items.map((m) =>

{m.name}

)}`. Each mug is a bare paragraph with no page or address of its own, so nothing can link to or quote one mug. ## Worth considering - **Give each mug its own page:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`: `

{m.name}

`. Routes like `/catalogue/:id` with price, size and glaze would give each mug an address people and machines can link to. - **Add Product structured data once mugs have pages:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`. Labelling the name, price and availability that are already visible might help machines read them. - **Add `alt` text to the hero image:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`: ``. A short description of the mug photo also tells machines what the picture shows. - **Say more on the home page:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:6`: `Thrown by hand in Bristol and shipped worldwide.` Add details a buyer would ask for: shipping times and costs, materials, care instructions and how to contact you. - **Add Organization or WebSite structured data:** `index.html` has no site identity. Name, URL and contact details you already show could be stated in a machine-readable way. - **Add `viewport` and social tags:** `index.html:4`: only `` is set. Add `viewport` plus Open Graph tags (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`) for link previews. - **Link onward from the home page to products:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:4-6` has no links to related pages, so a "Shop the catalogue" link would help. - **Make unknown addresses return a real 404:** `src/main.jsx:20-21` has no catch-all route, so a wrong URL shows a blank page rather than a "not found" page. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 (canonical):** the code sets no canonical and declares no domain. Tell me your site's domain and I can place canonicals. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Server responses:** real status codes and headers for `/robots.txt` and the pages need a live check. - **`/api/mugs`:** the backend that supplies the catalogue isn't in this repo. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site. There's no `geo.config.json`, so I assumed that. - I read all 6 tracked files: `index.html`, `package.json`, `public/robots.txt`, `src/main.jsx` and both pages. That covers the whole route table (2 routes), the navigation, the page head and the one `robots.txt`. I found no sitemap source, no JSON-LD, no canonical and no noindex. The site has no footer. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-003`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
